protocol.profile: v1.1.0 core, BM25 and shipped hybrid embeddinggemma / weight 1.5 / k5
protocol.unit: 16 invented independent entities, dev/test splits, DE/EN; no tuning on test
families: repeated value changes with return to initial value
protocol.truth: latest validity time for non-conflict; conflicting peers remain a set, not arbitrary truth
protocol.projection: reference type/equal storage dates; validity/source text in body, replacement links for current chain; no as-of API invoked
protocol.states: ingest each version, then terminal component reload, hidden-directory archive of old version, restore old version
protocol.archive_scope: filesystem fixture visibility only; not product archive API/security confirmation
metrics: old/current score ties and strict score advantages
old top1 with same current value versus incorrect value top1
protocol.gate: descriptive synthetic retrieval baseline; unsupported capabilities not passed
protocol.links: Replacement links follow validity order, not ingestion order; late-old never declares that it replaces the newer current fact.
protocol.order_control: Original and reversed version-ID/filename mapping and file creation order; chronology, bodies and queries unchanged. Controls are paired, not new independent entities.
protocol.primary_denominator: 56 non-conflict ingest trials at stage >=2 per arm/order; reload/restore repeats and archive visibility changes reported separately.
